AI Art Community: rules

Share images and stories made with generative tools and talk about technique.

  1. Every image or text made with generative AI must be tagged [AI] in the title.
  2. No links in posts; put your portfolio link in your profile instead.
  3. Posting limit: 5 images per day.
  4. Do not use bots to upvote or post.

Critique the work, not the person.
